exposure: Change in Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) guidelines regarding endotracheal suctioning in non-vigorous neonates born through meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF)
outcome: Persistent Pulmonary Hypertension of the Neonate (PPHN) diagnosis
cohort: Neonates born at >=34 weeks of gestation with meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) in a single center between 2010-2015 (pre-guideline change) and 2017-2022 (post-guideline change).
finding: Non-vigorous neonates born through MSAF after the change in NRP guidelines were less likely to be diagnosed with Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS) and Persistent Pulmonary Hypertension of the Neonate (PPHN), and less likely to receive surfactant.
